The '''Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation Limited''' ('''GETCO''') is an electrical power transmission company in the state of [[Gujarat]], [[India]]. It was set up in May 1999 and is registered under the Companies Act of 1956. The company was promoted by the erstwhile Gujarat Electricity Board (GEB)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gseb.com/guvnl/index.aspx|title=Welcome to GUVNL|website=Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited}}</ref> as its wholly owned-subsidiary in the context of liberalization and as a part of efforts towards restructuring of the power sector. The company is now a subsidiary of [[Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam]], the successor company to the GEB.
